spec.name: sprint45_taker_imbalance_cont_btc_eth
spec.hypothesis: Extreme 1m-aggregated taker buy/sell imbalance (top/bottom decile of trailing distribution) predicts same-direction continuation over the next 60 minutes, net of T2 fees.
spec.power_argument: Expected validation trades ~600 (2 symbols x cap 3/day x >=100d; window length to be verified by harness). Assumed per-trade sd ~50bps at 60m hold => SE ~2.9bps at n=300; min detectable net edge ~9bps at t>=3. Verdict 'underpowered' (not FAIL) if n<300. Precondition: loader smoke test n>0 on train window.
